page.overview:
Who is Professor Kukui?

Professor Kukui is the regional Pokémon professor of the Generation VII games, Pokémon Sun and Pokémon Moon and Pokémon Ultra Sun and Pokémon Ultra Moon, situated in the Alola region. He studies Pokémon moves, and is married to Professor Burnet.

His clothing is a perfect reflection of his laid-back, island lifestyle and energetic personality. He wears a white lab coat open and unbuttoned, revealing his bare, muscular chest—a bold choice that emphasizes his casual and confident nature. His outfit includes light gray, cropped athletic pants with black compression leggings underneath, blending comfort with practicality. He sports green flip-flop sandals, adding to his relaxed, beach-ready look. Kukui also wears a white cap featuring a colorful rainbow design, turned slightly sideways for extra flair, and stylish green-rimmed rectangular glasses that give him a distinctive and modern edge. His outfit balances the roles of a professional Pokémon Professor and a spirited, hands-on battler, standing out as uniquely Alolan and unmistakably Kukui.

The Masked Royal's clothing is a striking and theatrical wrestling outfit that perfectly embodies his fiery, energetic persona. He wears a red and black luchador-style mask adorned with golden accents and bold angular designs, concealing his identity while exuding power and charisma. His muscular torso is left bare, showcasing his strength, while a dramatic red cape with jagged black trim flows behind him, adding flair to his movements. He sports tight red wrestling tights decorated with black flame motifs, complemented by black gloves and sturdy black boots. The vibrant color palette and dramatic styling capture the spirit of a showman, blending the excitement of professional wrestling with the intensity of Pokémon battles, making the Masked Royal a larger-than-life figure in the Alola region. Later, he wears a Z-Ring on his left arm.

The Professor is upbeat, passionate, and full of warmth. He's known for his enthusiasm for Pokémon battles, often getting fired up when talking about them, which reflects his deep love for both the sport and the bond between Trainers and Pokémon. Despite being a professor, he breaks the mold of the traditional academic—he's hands-on, physically active, and incredibly approachable. Kukui is friendly, supportive, and charismatic, serving as a mentor and father figure to many young Trainers in the Alola region. He values learning through experience and encourages others to grow by facing challenges head-on. His laid-back, island-style demeanor is balanced by a strong sense of responsibility and genuine care for others, making him both a respected researcher and a beloved role model.
